title: Slow Cooker Tortellini and Cheese
description: A creamy and cheesy tortellini dish cooked effortlessly in the slow cooker, perfect for Easter or any occasion.

ingredients.item: refrigerated tortellini (from the refrigerated section, e.g., Sam's Club or Costco)
cream cheese (preferably whipped for easier blending)
slices Land of Lakes American cheese (or similar processed cheese)

steps: Place all ingredients into the slow cooker.
Set the slow cooker to low and stir periodically.
Check after 1.5 hours to see how tender the tortellini are.
Cook for about 2 hours total, then give it a final stir.
Serve and enjoy the creamy tortellini and cheese mixture.
notes:
Stir periodically to prevent sticking and ensure even heating. Adjust seasoning to taste.

healthy: Cheese and milk give protein and calcium.
not_healthy: Heavy cream, cream cheese, butter, cheddar and American cheese make it very high in saturated fat.
Processed American cheese and cheddar add a lot of sodium.
Cheese tortellini is refined pasta with no vegetables.
